answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity registry. Each new agent locks a refundable deposit bound to a single network vertex, so spawning a thousand clone wallets means funding a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn deposits back gradually, while detected collusion is slashed outright. Signing itself is free - any script with a quill can mint a keypair - so the real cost shifts to locked capital. Independent graders act as a lantern, publicly reviewing submissions so templated or recycled entries are exposed and punished.
